defect: An empty/crossed incoming book did not invalidate an earlier recent valid decision quote. This could allow a decision from a book already known invalid.
repair: Remove cached quote and reset local momentum history on invalid/empty records. Preserve original result, rerun same source hashes into a new filename. No strategy threshold or cost change.
pending_positions: Missing exits never become zero PnL; retain unresolved states and exclude qualification.
preliminary_cap: At most1000preliminarytickerattempts for bounded metadata joins, then enforce original100eligible-eventattemptcap after official metadata validation. This resource cap never extends after PnL inspection.
